thread:
maria_pm: Quick idea — surface routing / quota hints directly on saved queries in the console. Per-route view: small pills showing current routing tier, estimated token burn, and a rollback-safety flag. Would help product teams choose defaults during model rollouts. Thoughts?

sam_engineer: +1. We'll need an API shape change so savedQuery returns routingHint metadata. Something like routingHints: {tier, fallback_tier, est_tokens, sample_rate, stability}.

lee_design: Love this. UX thought: show 1-line pill row under the saved query title (icons + short text). Hover or click opens a compact card with more details and a "simulate routing" CTA. :sparkles:

shaun_sre: Caution: exposing exact fallback model names might leak capacity churn info. Could we surface only friendly labels (fast/robust/cheap) and a stability indicator instead of model IDs?

katie_devex: Also: a "simulate routing" should let users preview estimated latency/cost for a given sample payload. Could be a sandboxed call that doesn't count against production quotas.

sam_engineer: For simulate, running the full routing decision path is heavier. Suggest an async preview endpoint that queries the routing policy engine with a small sample and returns a summary. Sync for small requests only.

telemetry-bot: telemetry: saved_query.routing_preview.requested incremented by 1 for saved_query_id=SQ-8472

maria_pm: Agree with Shaun on obfuscation. Proposal: show tier names + stability badge (high/medium/low) and a neutral "fallback present" indicator. Keep exact model names behind a permission or in the audit log only.

lee_design: I'll explore two mocks: (A) inline pills + hover card, (B) inline pills + inline expandable details. Both will include a lightweight chart of recent routing stability. Will post Figma links.

sam_engineer: Prototype API snippet I'm planning to add to saved query response:

```
{
  "routing_hint": {
    "tier": "fast",
    "fallback_tier": "robust",
    "est_tokens": "~1200",
    "sample_rate": "5%",
    "stability": "high"
  }
}
```

shaun_sre: For privacy: we should run this through legal and confirm we don't expose customer-specific capacity signals. Also define a denylist of internal tags.

katie_devex: Need an audit row whenever routing_hint changes (who changed it, old vs new). Also wire telemetry: routing_hint.viewed, simulate.clicked.

maria_pm: Action items: Lee -> mocks by Thu; Sam -> proto endpoint + backend contract by Fri for dev testing; Shaun -> privacy/legal check; Katie -> audit + telemetry plan. I'll sync with Sales/CS about messaging. Thanks all! :party-parrot:

sam_engineer: quick followup — can we add a small icon denoting SLA tier so customers can immediately see if a saved query is on a guaranteed path or a best-effort one?

lee_design: yep, will include SLA icon variants in mocks.

maria_pm: Perfect. We'll keep this on the smaller rollout path; can A/B test exposing full detail vs friendly labels.

katie_devex: Noted, adding experiment flags to the plan.

shaun_sre: :thumbsup:

telemetry-bot: deploy-bot: routing-hint-service v0.4 deployed to staging

sam_engineer: I'll open a draft PR with the API contract + sample telemetry events.

maria_pm: Great — thanks everyone.
